chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who partners his father, and his brother, and his relatives in his Hajj, he said: 'Then, a Hajj will be written for you similar to their Hajj, and your reward will be increased due to what you linked (with them).'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a man who includes his father and brother in his Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the spiritual mechanics of 'sharing' Hajg rewards, establishing that including relatives in one's pilgrimage multiplies the individual's reward rather than diminishing it. This ruling highlights the Shia emphasis on familial piety (Silat al-Rahim) as a means of augmenting worship, where the pilgrim's act of linking their kin grants them a distinct, complete Hajj reward for each relative. The hadith underscores the communal and familial dimensions of Hajj, reinforcing the idea that good deeds performed with or for family members yield compounded divine favor.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hisham Bin Al Hakam,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who participated his father, and his brother, and his relatives in his Hajj. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then, a Hajj would be Written for him similar to their Hajj, and a Recompense would be increased due to what he linked’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about assigning a share of one’s al-Hajj for his father, brother or relatives.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Obviously, al-Hajj will be written for you like their al-Hajj, in addition to the reward for your maintaining good relation, with relatives.’”
